collection.title: Nissan GT-R 2016 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Nissan GT-R 2016 - 2022 model requires a 22" wiper blade for both the drivers and a 20" blade on the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
